item.title: Critical Incident Family Support Team takes shape in county
item.description: A community initiative, the Critical Incident Family Support Team (CIFST), is continuing to take shape to provide compassionate support to families and loved ones affected by critical incidents involving first responders, schools, or major community emergencies.
